senses.en: Standards used to judge something or make a decision.

ex.en: Office hours began with selection criteria.
ex.zh: 答疑从筛选标准开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of selection criteria.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得筛选标准这个例子。

tip: criteria是复数，单数为criterion；用criteria are。

senses.en: To communicate or do things with other people.
To affect one another when combined or brought together.

ex.en: The assignment is to interact with, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先与……互动，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to interact with.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们与……互动。

col: interact with each other｜相互交流
tip: 不及物动词：与某人互动用interact with someone。

senses.en: believing certain actions or objects bring good or bad luck

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on superstitious beliefs.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论迷信观念。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of superstitious beliefs.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得迷信观念这个例子。

tip: 常用be superstitious about表示对某事迷信。

senses.en: A national body of representatives that makes laws.
A large formal meeting of representatives or specialists.

ex.en: Office hours began with a national congress.
ex.zh: 答疑从全国代表大会开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a national congress with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把全国代表大会和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a national congress｜全国代表大会
a member of Congress｜国会议员
tip: 特指美国等国家的国会时，通常大写Congress。

senses.en: sudden strong fear that makes clear thinking difficult
to feel or cause sudden fear and lose calm

ex.en: I copied panic attack into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把惊恐发作抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss panic attack.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论惊恐发作的材料。

tip: 过去式panicked、进行式panicking均须在c后加k。

senses.en: Very bad, intense, or damaging.
Very strict or harsh in treatment or judgment.

ex.en: Office hours began with severe pain.
ex.zh: 答疑从剧痛开始。

ex.en: The author returns to severe pain when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了剧痛。

tip: 可修饰疼痛、天气、短缺或惩罚，表示程度重。

senses.en: The purpose or job of something or someone.
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: Our professor circled basic function on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了基本功能。

ex.en: A campus survey used basic function to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用基本功能来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

senses.en: Probably true, based on what is known or reasonably expected.

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to presumably because.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习大概是因为。

ex.en: Students who presumably because are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够大概是因为的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: 表示有依据的推测，不等于certainly的确定语气。

senses.en: Organising people or activities so they work effectively together
The ability to move different body parts smoothly together

ex.en: Our professor circled hand-eye coordination on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了手眼协调能力。

ex.en: The author returns to hand-eye coordination when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了手眼协调能力。

col: coordination between departments｜部门之间的协调
tip: 通常不可数；between引出需要协调的双方或多方。

senses.en: to cause a person or organism to develop an infection
to spread a feeling or attitude to others

ex.en: I heard the lecturer infect a wound during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时使伤口感染。

ex.en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers infect a wound before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要使伤口感染。

col: infect someone with a virus｜使某人感染病毒
tip: 常用infect someone with a virus，表示使某人感染病毒。

senses.en: deeply loved by someone or many people
a person whom someone loves deeply

ex.en: The textbook introduces a beloved friend in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了挚爱的朋友。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a beloved friend.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕挚爱的朋友展开说明。

col: a beloved institution｜深受喜爱的机构
tip: 通常作形容词；作名词指爱人，语气较文学化。

senses.en: The work or skill of making and repairing wooden structures.

ex.en: The textbook introduces basic carpentry in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了基础木工。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around basic carpentry.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕基础木工展开说明。

tip: carpentry指技艺或工作；carpenter指木匠。

senses.en: Unlikely to work well or be useful in practice
Not skilled at handling everyday practical tasks

ex.en: Office hours began with highly impractical.
ex.zh: 答疑从极不实用的开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of highly impractical.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得极不实用的这个例子。

col: an impractical solution｜不切实际的解决办法
impractical for everyday use｜不适合日常使用
tip: 是形容词，不是动词；不实用不一定是不可能。

senses.en: relating to machines or their moving parts
done without thought, interest, or feeling

ex.en: Office hours began with mechanical engineering.
ex.zh: 答疑从机械工程开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used mechanical engineering to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用机械工程来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

col: a mechanical response｜机械式的回应
tip: mechanical指机器相关；mechanic指机械修理工。

senses.en: A substance formed from chemically joined elements.

senses.zh: 围墙内的场地或建筑群
senses.en: An enclosed area containing buildings.
To make an existing problem or difficulty worse.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on chemical compound.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论化合物。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss chemical compound.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论化合物的材料。

tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: To take someone away illegally and hold them captive

ex.en: The assignment is to kidnap someone for ransom, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先绑架某人索取赎金，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to kidnap someone for ransom and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你绑架某人索取赎金，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: kidnap someone for ransom｜绑架某人索取赎金
tip: 不限于儿童；常用过去式kidnapped，分词kidnapping。

senses.en: relating to the rules for forming words and sentences
following the accepted grammar rules of a language

ex.en: The textbook introduces grammatical accuracy in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了语法准确性。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of grammatical accuracy.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得语法准确性这个例子。

tip: 可指“语法方面的”，也可指句子“符合语法的”。

senses.en: goods available for sale
to promote goods and encourage people to buy them

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sell merchandise.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论销售商品。

ex.en: A campus survey used sell merchandise to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用销售商品来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 名词不可数；动词词尾常读作/daɪz/。

senses.en: Safe or suitable to eat.

ex.en: Office hours began with edible plants.
ex.zh: 答疑从可食用植物开始。

ex.en: The reading connects edible plants with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可食用植物和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: edible表示能吃，不表示美味；勿凭外观判断野生植物。

senses.en: Prevent an activity or system from continuing normally.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to disrupt traffic.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求扰乱交通。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to disrupt traffic.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来扰乱交通。

tip: 及物动词，直接接活动或系统；不是形容词。

senses.en: A particular example or occurrence of something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an isolated instance.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论个别事例。

ex.en: The reading connects an isolated instance with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把个别事例和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: in this instance｜在这种情况下
tip: for instance意为“例如”，作用类似for example。

senses.en: At risk of harm, loss, or extinction.
Feeling that someone or something may cause harm or loss.

ex.en: The textbook introduces threatened species in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了受威胁物种。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of threatened species.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得受威胁物种这个例子。

col: threatened with extinction｜面临灭绝威胁
tip: threatened指受到威胁；threatening指构成威胁。

senses.en: Make a long, loud cry or a similar rushing sound.
A long, loud cry expressing pain, anger, or another strong feeling.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to howl at the moon.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须对月长嚎。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers howl at the moon before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要对月长嚎。

col: howl at the moon｜对月长嚎
howls of protest｜愤怒的抗议声
tip: 既用于动物长嚎，也用于风声或人的强烈反应。

senses.en: Most important among several things.
Having the highest rank in an organisation or profession.
The person who leads a group or organisation.

ex.en: The textbook introduces police chief in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了警察局长。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of police chief.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得警察局长这个例子。

tip: chief可作形容词或名词；副词用chiefly。

senses.en: Through another person, thing, or stage rather than directly
Without expressing something clearly or openly

ex.en: The professor told us to indirectly affect and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们间接影响，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: Students who indirectly affect are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够间接影响的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

col: indirectly responsible for｜对……负有间接责任
directly or indirectly｜直接或间接地
tip: 是副词，不是形容词；修饰动词时用indirectly。

senses.en: made or caused by people rather than occurring naturally

ex.en: After the lecture, we used man-made in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了人造的。

ex.en: A reading on environmental policy uses man-made when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于环境政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了人造的。

tip: 强调由人制造或造成；也可用human-made。

senses.en: Completely unreasonable or silly.

ex.en: I copied completely absurd into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把完全荒谬的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used completely absurd to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用完全荒谬的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 常用句式：It is absurd to do sth.。

senses.en: a period of rapid growth or economic success
a loud, deep sound
to grow rapidly or make a loud, deep sound

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on economic boom.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济繁荣。

ex.en: A campus survey used economic boom to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用经济繁荣来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: a boom in tourism｜旅游业的迅猛发展
a booming industry｜蓬勃发展的行业
tip: 表示某领域的迅速增长，常用a boom in。

senses.en: The movement of people to live in another place.
The regular movement of animals between regions, often with the seasons.
The transfer of data or software to another computer system.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about rural-to-urban migration.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于农村向城市的人口迁移的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to rural-to-urban migration when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了农村向城市的人口迁移。

col: rural-to-urban migration｜农村向城市的人口迁移
tip: migration泛指迁移；immigration侧重迁入。

senses.en: Related to volcanoes or produced by their activity.
Sudden and extremely powerful, especially when describing anger.

ex.en: I copied volcanic eruption into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把火山喷发抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss volcanic eruption.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论火山喷发的材料。

tip: 通常作形容词；“火山岩”用volcanic rock。

senses.en: Using measurement units such as metres, litres, and grams.
A measurement used to judge performance, quality, or progress.

ex.en: Our professor circled performance metric on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了绩效指标。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss performance metric.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论绩效指标的材料。

tip: 形容词指公制的；名词指指标，常用复数。

senses.en: having excessive body fat that may harm health

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about clinically obese.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于临床诊断为肥胖的的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects clinically obese with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把临床诊断为肥胖的和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: clinically obese｜临床诊断为肥胖的
tip: 属医学用语，程度通常重于overweight；避免随意评价他人。

senses.en: A small mammal with spines that curls into a ball.

ex.en: I copied a baby hedgehog into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把刺猬幼崽抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a baby hedgehog.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得刺猬幼崽这个例子。

tip: hedgehog是刺猬；porcupine是豪猪，两者不是同一种动物。

senses.en: A short written message, especially between people at work.

ex.en: I copied internal memo into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把内部通知抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to internal memo when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了内部通知。

col: a memo about something｜关于某事的备忘录
tip: memo常指工作中的简短内部通知，复数为memos。

senses.en: A feeling of worry about something important

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项
senses.en: An issue that matters or causes worry
To relate to someone or something, or cause worry

ex.en: Office hours began with a major concern.
ex.zh: 答疑从一个主要问题开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a major concern when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一个主要问题。

col: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧
a major concern｜一个主要问题
concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

senses.en: to examine something carefully to understand its parts or causes

ex.en: The assignment is to analyse data, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先分析数据，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers analyse data before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要分析数据。

tip: 英式拼写analyse，美式通常写analyze。

senses.en: relating to technology and its practical development

ex.en: I copied technological advances into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把科技进步抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to technological advances when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了科技进步。

tip: technological侧重科技发展，technical侧重具体技术。

senses.en: The way or amount that something is used.
The customary way words or phrases are used in language.

ex.en: The textbook introduces energy usage in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了能源使用量。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around energy usage.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕能源使用量展开说明。

tip: usage重在使用量、使用方式或语言惯用法。

senses.en: required by a law or rule, rather than optional

ex.en: Office hours began with compulsory education.
ex.zh: 答疑从义务教育开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around compulsory education.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕义务教育展开说明。

tip: compulsory强调规定必须做，与optional相对。

senses.en: communication channels that deliver information to very large audiences

ex.en: The professor explained mass media with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了大众传媒。

ex.en: Students who can explain mass media usually follow the rest of a lecture on public communication.
ex.zh: 能解释大众传媒的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共传播的讲座。

col: mass media coverage｜大众媒体报道
mass media influence｜大众传媒的影响
tip: 泛指大众传媒常用the mass media，通常接复数谓语。

senses.en: a tiny electronic component containing many connected circuits
a small broken piece or the mark it leaves
to break a small piece off something

ex.en: Our professor circled computer chip on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了计算机芯片。

ex.en: A campus survey used computer chip to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用计算机芯片来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

col: a chip in a cup｜杯子上的缺口
chip a tooth｜磕掉一小块牙齿
tip: 食物中的chips：英式指薯条，美式通常指薯片。

senses.en: Connected with a religion and treated with deep respect

ex.en: Our professor circled holy place on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了圣地。

ex.en: A campus survey used holy place to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用圣地来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: holy强调宗教上的神圣，与wholly发音相同。

senses.en: an uncomfortable feeling caused by awkwardness or fear of others' judgment
a person or thing that causes shame or awkwardness

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about blush with embarrassment.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于尴尬得脸红的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around blush with embarrassment.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕尴尬得脸红展开说明。

col: to my embarrassment｜令我尴尬的是
a source of embarrassment｜令人尴尬的根源
tip: 情绪义不可数；指令人尴尬的人或事时可数。

senses.en: the process of giving or delivering things to different people
the way something is spread across an area or group

ex.en: The textbook introduces population distribution in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了人口分布。

ex.en: A campus survey used population distribution to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用人口分布来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 既指分发过程，也指人口等的分布状态。

senses.en: a group that decides facts in a court case
a group that judges entries in a competition

ex.en: I copied jury verdict into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把陪审团裁决抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects jury verdict with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把陪审团裁决和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: serve on a jury｜担任陪审员
tip: jury指整个陪审团；单个陪审员叫juror。

senses.en: Difficult in a way that tests skills or determination.
Expressing doubt or inviting disagreement or competition.

ex.en: Office hours began with intellectually challenging.
ex.zh: 答疑从考验智力的开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used intellectually challenging to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用考验智力的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 形容任务有难度用challenging，不用challenged。

senses.en: to shine with small, bright flashes of light
bright flashes of light, or a lively, exciting quality

ex.en: The lab instructions say to sparkle in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求在阳光下闪耀。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to sparkle in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得在阳光下闪耀。

col: sparkle in the sunlight｜在阳光下闪耀
tip: sparkle强调点点闪光；shine泛指发光。

senses.en: to willingly accept an idea, change, or opportunity
to hold someone closely in your arms
an act of holding someone closely in your arms

ex.en: The professor asked us to embrace change.
ex.zh: 教授让我们欣然接受变化。

ex.en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers embrace change before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要欣然接受变化。

col: embrace an opportunity｜欣然把握机会
tip: 表示接受时，常接change、idea等抽象名词。

senses.en: In addition, introducing another point supporting what was said

ex.en: Furthermore, the class checked the chart a second time.
ex.zh: 此外，全班又核对了一次图表。

ex.en: Furthermore, readers should separate what the passage proves from what it only suggests.
ex.zh: 此外，读者应当区分文章证明了什么，又仅仅暗示了什么。

col: furthermore, it is important｜此外，重要的是
furthermore, evidence suggests｜此外，证据表明
tip: 正式递进副词；连接完整句时，前面用句号或分号。

senses.en: a meeting or explanation giving essential information or instructions

ex.en: Our professor circled safety briefing on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了安全说明会。

ex.en: A campus survey used safety briefing to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用安全说明会来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 不只是书面简报，也常指口头说明或简报会。

senses.en: Containing many things packed closely together
Difficult to understand because information is tightly packed
Slow to understand things

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on dense fog.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论浓雾。

ex.en: The reading connects dense fog with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把浓雾和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 形容人愚钝时有冒犯意味；密集地用densely。

senses.en: Large in amount or importance.

ex.en: There was a substantial gap between the two groups.
ex.zh: 两组之间有很大的差距。

ex.en: The lecture called the improvement substantial, not merely statistically detectable.
ex.zh: 讲座称这一改进是实质性的，而不只是统计上能检测出来。

tip: 不要和 substantive（实质的、有内容的）混淆。

senses.en: Unable to protect yourself or change a difficult situation

ex.en: The textbook introduces a helpless victim in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了无助的受害者。

ex.en: A campus survey used a helpless victim to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用无助的受害者来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: a helpless victim｜无助的受害者
tip: helpless是无助的；unhelpful是不肯帮忙或无用的。

senses.en: Certain to happen and impossible to prevent

ex.en: The textbook introduces almost inevitable in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了几乎不可避免的。

ex.en: The reading connects almost inevitable with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把几乎不可避免的和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常用it is inevitable that…表示“……不可避免”。

senses.en: a social group sharing ancestry, traditions, and community ties

ex.en: Our professor circled a nomadic tribe on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了游牧部落。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a nomadic tribe.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕游牧部落展开说明。

col: members of a tribe｜部落成员
tip: 指特定社群时，宜尊重其自称，避免泛称。

senses.en: Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable.

senses.zh: 最精彩或最重要的部分
senses.en: The best or most memorable part of an experience.
Mark words with bright colour to make them noticeable.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer highlight a problem during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时突出一个问题。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to highlight a problem.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来突出一个问题。

col: highlight a problem｜突出一个问题
highlight the importance of｜强调……的重要性
the highlight of the trip｜旅途中最精彩的部分
tip: 作动词直接接宾语：highlight the problem。

senses.en: Willing to take risks or act with confidence.
Strong and easily noticed in colour, shape, or design.
Printed with thicker, darker lines than ordinary type.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about bold decision.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于大胆的决定的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around bold decision.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大胆的决定展开说明。

tip: in bold表示“用粗体”，常用于排版说明。

senses.en: The likelihood that something will happen.
The ratio determining how much a successful bet pays.

ex.en: Office hours began with against all odds.
ex.zh: 答疑从尽管困难重重开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around against all odds.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕尽管困难重重展开说明。

col: the odds of success｜成功的可能性
against all odds｜尽管困难重重
improve the odds｜提高成功机会
tip: odds用复数形式，常接of或that从句。

senses.en: the act of working together towards a shared goal
willingness to help or do what someone requests

ex.en: Office hours began with international cooperation.
ex.zh: 答疑从国际合作开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of international cooperation.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得国际合作这个例子。

tip: 通常不可数；与……合作用in cooperation with。

senses.en: a small part or amount of something
a mathematical quantity representing part of a whole

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a small fraction.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论很小一部分。

ex.en: A campus survey used a small fraction to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用很小一部分来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: a fraction of a second｜极短的一瞬
tip: a fraction of常强调占比极小，不只是一般部分。

senses.en: the ability to change or adapt to different needs
the ability to bend or stretch easily

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about greater flexibility.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于更大的灵活性的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects greater flexibility with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把更大的灵活性和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: flexibility in working hours｜工作时间的灵活性
tip: 既可指安排可变通，也可指身体或材料的柔韧性。

senses.en: express disapproval of someone or something

ex.en: The professor asked us to criticize someone for something.
ex.zh: 教授让我们因某事批评某人。

ex.en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers criticize someone for something before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要因某事批评某人。

col: criticize someone for something｜因某事批评某人
tip: criticize sb for sth；英式也常拼作criticise。

senses.en: The act or state of finishing something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces near completion in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了接近完工。

ex.en: The author returns to near completion when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了接近完工。

tip: 常用on completion of表示“在……完成时”。

senses.en: words or ideas that are absurd or have no meaning
silly or unacceptable behaviour

ex.en: I copied talk nonsense into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把胡说八道抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around talk nonsense.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕胡说八道展开说明。

col: a load of nonsense｜一堆废话
put up with nonsense｜容忍胡闹
tip: 通常不可数；说一派胡言可用 complete nonsense。

senses.en: A school providing training in a particular subject or skill.
An organization promoting scholarship, science, or the arts.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a music academy in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了音乐学院。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a music academy.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论音乐学院的材料。

tip: 常指专业培训院校或学术机构，不一定是大学。

senses.en: To judge an approximate amount, value, or size.
An approximate calculation of an amount, value, or cost.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to estimate the cost.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何估算费用。

ex.en: The reading asks you to estimate the cost and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你估算费用，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 动词末尾读/eɪt/；名词末尾读/ət/。

senses.en: Someone who judges and discusses artistic works professionally.
Someone who expresses disapproval of a person, policy, or idea.

ex.en: Office hours began with film critic.
ex.zh: 答疑从影评人开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss film critic.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论影评人的材料。

col: an outspoken critic｜直言不讳的批评者
tip: critic指人，criticism指批评或评论。

senses.en: important or unusual enough to deserve attention
a famous or important person, especially in a particular community

ex.en: Office hours began with a notable achievement.
ex.zh: 答疑从显著成就开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a notable achievement with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把显著成就和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a notable exception｜值得注意的例外
tip: notable for表示因……而出名或引人注意。

senses.en: a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture

ex.en: Our professor circled sulphur dioxide on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了二氧化硫。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sulphur dioxide.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论二氧化硫的材料。

tip: sulphur是传统英式拼写；科学文献常用sulfur。

senses.en: Accept responsibility for a task and begin doing it
Promise to do something

ex.en: I heard the lecturer undertake research during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时开展研究。

ex.en: The reading asks you to undertake research and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你开展研究，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: undertake to do something｜承诺做某事
tip: 过去式undertook，过去分词undertaken。

senses.en: to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen
an opening in a floor, ceiling, or wall
to develop a plan, often secretly

ex.en: The assignment is to hatch an egg, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先孵蛋，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to hatch an egg.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得孵蛋。

tip: 表示孵化用动词；名词常指舱口或小开口。

senses.en: To move to another country to live there permanently.

ex.en: The professor asked us to immigrate to a country.
ex.zh: 教授让我们移居某国。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to immigrate to a country.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们移居某国。

col: immigrate to a country｜移居某国
tip: immigrate to强调移入；emigrate from强调移出。

senses.en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog
a short, loud sound made by a dog
the outer protective layer of a tree trunk or branch

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to bark at someone.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何冲某人吠叫。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to bark at someone.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来冲某人吠叫。

col: a loud bark｜一声响亮的狗叫
tip: 狗叫声可数；树皮通常不可数。

senses.en: The clearing of forests by cutting down trees.

ex.en: Office hours began with prevent deforestation.
ex.zh: 答疑从防止毁林开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of prevent deforestation.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得防止毁林这个例子。

tip: 不可数名词；常用于栖息地丧失和气候变化话题。

senses.en: Someone employed to help people in a public place.
Occurring together with something, often as a consequence.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on flight attendant.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论航空乘务员。

ex.en: A campus survey used flight attendant to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用航空乘务员来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: car park attendant｜停车场管理员
tip: attendant常指服务人员；参会者通常用attendee。

senses.en: deep sadness caused by loss or disappointment

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on deep sorrow.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论深切的悲痛。

ex.en: The reading connects deep sorrow with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把深切的悲痛和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示悲伤情绪通常不可数；具体伤心事可数。

senses.en: to prevent a device or feature from working
to cause a condition that limits someone's activities

ex.en: The lab instructions say to disable notifications.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求禁用通知。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to disable notifications.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得禁用通知。

col: disable location tracking｜禁用位置追踪
tip: 技术语境常指“禁用”，不表示删除或损坏。

senses.en: to remember something from the past
to order someone back or request the return of products
the ability to remember, or an official request for returns

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to recall a detail.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何回想起一个细节。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to recall a detail.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得回想起一个细节。

col: recall a detail｜回想起一个细节
recall doing something｜记得做过某事
tip: 表示记得做过某事用 recall doing，不用 to do。

senses.en: Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive.
Exceptionally good or skilfully done.

ex.en: Our professor circled magnificent scenery on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了壮丽的景色。

ex.en: The author returns to magnificent scenery when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了壮丽的景色。

tip: 多形容景色、建筑或成就，不表示品德高尚。

senses.en: A feeling of gratitude for someone's help or kindness.
Recognition and understanding of something's value, quality, or importance.
An increase in the financial value of something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on currency appreciation.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论货币升值。

ex.en: The reading connects currency appreciation with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把货币升值和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an appreciation of art｜对艺术的欣赏
tip: 通常不可数；an appreciation of可指对某事的理解。

senses.en: a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry
to give someone a heavy responsibility or worry

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial burden.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济负担。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of financial burden.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得经济负担这个例子。

col: be burdened with debt｜背负债务
tip: 负担落在某人身上用a burden on someone。

senses.en: To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to vibrate gently.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何轻轻振动。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to vibrate gently.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来轻轻振动。

tip: 指快速、小幅度振动，不等于大幅摇摆。

senses.en: A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a young lad.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小伙子。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a young lad.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论小伙子的材料。

col: a teenage lad｜十几岁的男孩
tip: 偏英式口语；正式写作宜用boy或young man。

senses.en: a condition that disrupts normal physical or mental functioning
a state in which things are not properly arranged
uncontrolled public behaviour that disturbs peace or safety

ex.en: I copied sleep disorder into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把睡眠障碍抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects sleep disorder with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把睡眠障碍和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 疾病义可数；杂乱或骚乱义通常不可数。

senses.en: to move to another region, seasonally or to live there
to move data or software to a different computer system

ex.en: The professor asked us to migrate south.
ex.zh: 教授让我们向南迁徙。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to migrate south.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来向南迁徙。

tip: migrate强调迁移；immigrate移入，emigrate移出。

senses.en: relating to collective ownership and more equal distribution of wealth
someone who supports socialism

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about socialist policies.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于社会主义政策的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects socialist policies with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把社会主义政策和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: socialist指社会主义的；social仅指社会的或社交的。

senses.en: A large sea animal with a hard shell and claws.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on lobster fishing.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论龙虾捕捞。

ex.en: A campus survey used lobster fishing to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用龙虾捕捞来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 指动物时可数；指作为食物的虾肉时不可数。

senses.en: A particular part of an economy or area of activity.
A particular section of a larger area.
A circle's part enclosed by two radii and an arc.

ex.en: Our professor circled the public sector on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公共部门。

ex.en: The author returns to the public sector when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公共部门。

tip: sector常指经济中的某个行业，不一定是公司部门。

senses.en: the act or ceremony of placing a dead body underground

ex.en: Our professor circled burial site on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了墓葬遗址。

ex.en: The author returns to burial site when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了墓葬遗址。

tip: burial重在入土安葬；funeral泛指葬礼仪式。

senses.en: a unit used to measure power

ex.en: Office hours began with a ten-watt bulb.
ex.zh: 答疑从十瓦灯泡开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a ten-watt bulb.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕十瓦灯泡展开说明。

col: power in watts｜以瓦特表示的功率
rated at fifty watts｜额定功率为五十瓦
tip: 瓦特衡量功率；千瓦时衡量用电量。

senses.en: limited in amount, range, or freedom
available or open only to people with permission

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on restricted access.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论受限的使用权限。

ex.en: The reading connects restricted access with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把受限的使用权限和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a restricted area｜限制进入的区域
tip: restricted to表示“仅限于”；也是restrict过去分词。

senses.en: Something that takes your attention away from your main activity
The state of being unable to give something full attention
An activity that helps you forget worries or boredom

ex.en: I copied a welcome distraction into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把令人愉快的消遣抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a welcome distraction when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了令人愉快的消遣。

col: a welcome distraction｜令人愉快的消遣
tip: 具体干扰物可数；表示分心状态时通常不可数。

senses.en: Stealing from a person or place using force or threats.

ex.en: Office hours began with armed robbery.
ex.zh: 答疑从持械抢劫开始。

ex.en: The reading connects armed robbery with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把持械抢劫和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: robbery涉及暴力或威胁；theft泛指盗窃。

senses.en: A ridge of rock or coral near the sea's surface.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on coral reef.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论珊瑚礁。

ex.en: The reading connects coral reef with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把珊瑚礁和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: reef指接近海面的礁体，不是海边的悬崖cliff。

senses.en: laugh in a light, often nervous or silly way
a light laugh caused by amusement or nervousness

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to giggle at a joke.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何听到笑话咯咯笑。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers giggle at a joke before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要听到笑话咯咯笑。

col: giggle at a joke｜听到笑话咯咯笑
tip: 强调轻轻咯咯笑，可因好玩或紧张；笑某事用at。

senses.en: a serious disagreement between people or groups
to question whether something is true or correct
to argue about something or compete to control it

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a dispute over pay.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论薪酬争议。

ex.en: The reading connects a dispute over pay with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把薪酬争议和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a dispute over pay｜薪酬争议
dispute a claim｜质疑某项说法
tip: dispute a claim是质疑说法，不是讨论说法。

senses.en: A state of not understanding something clearly
A situation where things are mixed up or poorly organised

ex.en: Office hours began with clear up confusion.
ex.zh: 答疑从消除困惑开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of clear up confusion.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得消除困惑这个例子。

tip: 人感到困惑用confused；事物令人困惑用confusing。

senses.en: Relating to factories and the production of goods.

ex.en: I copied industrial production into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把工业生产抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects industrial production with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把工业生产和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: industrial指工业的；industrious才指勤劳的。

senses.en: an established series of actions for completing a task
a medical action performed to diagnose or treat a condition

ex.en: The textbook introduces standard procedure in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了标准程序。

ex.en: A campus survey used standard procedure to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用标准程序来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: procedure 强调规定步骤；process 更侧重整个过程。

senses.en: To manage a difficult situation successfully.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer cope with stress during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时应对压力。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cope with stress.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得应对压力。

tip: cope是不及物动词，接困难或压力时用with。
